messages:
carlo: FYI — planned control-plane failover + warm failover load test tonight 23:00 UTC. target window 45m. low-customer-impact expected. details below.

alisha: TL;DR: we'll drain nodes in us-east-1 and route live traffic to us-west and eu-west for 30m, then fail back.

ben: running a small canary at 22:50 to validate prefix cache hits and KV restore. please ack if you have any sticky sessions to hand off.

zoe: I have two DMS jobs that could re-create connections — will pause at 22:40. :white_check_mark:

carlo: Runbook excerpt:
```
- 22:40 pause long-running DMS
- 22:50 start 1% canary (traffic-shaper)
- 23:00 drain target pool (kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets)
- 23:05 observe 5xx, p95 latency, token per-request cost
- 23:25 start failback
```

alisha: SLO note: we'll temporarily relax request-latency SLO from 99.9% -> 99.5% for this window. incident bot will annotate rollups.

oncall-bot: @channel scheduled-maintenance created: id mnt-1786, start 1786004400, end 1786007100 — see /maint mnt-1786

ben: Monitoring checks to watch: `edge-queue-length`, `inflight-requests`, `model-kv-cache-hit` — I'm adding automated alerts that will page if p95 > 450ms for 3m.

zoe: Confirmed: dashboards updated, alert thresholds set. I also added a synthetic that hits the small quantized fallback model.

carlo: Risk notes: cold-start spikiness for new containers and temporary increased token cost due to reduced batching. No API key changes. No customer opt-in required.

alisha: If anyone sees sustained 5xx > 1% for 5m, start rollback immediately and ping #incidents and @oncall.

ben: Quick command I'll run after drain to speed up warmup:
```
for i in {1..100}; do curl -sS "$CANARY_URL/?warm=1" >/dev/null; done
```

zoe: I'll be on standby at 22:30-00:30 UTC. ping me if canary fails. :rocket:

carlo: Everyone ack please. I'll post a short postmortem template in this thread after the window.

alisha: ack

ben: ack

zoe: ack

carlo: closing loop: starting canary in 20m. will update thread with first metrics.
